strings.VNS_Blood_of_Proletariat_desc:
With the turning of the industrial age, the once tranquil lakes and rivers of Venezuela's heartlands were turned black as her arteries were slashed and the thicken black ooze poured forth - to be devoured by the vampiric forces of capital which long leered over them. The revolution has come to bring an end to her era of tragedy, with this oozing wound now wrapped tight.

Sickening greed and ambition have been curtailed as the hands of the proletariat inherit their birthright and the riches of the oil that once made Venezuela the playground of empires, is hers once again.
strings.VNS_National_Chorus_desc:
Many times, in times of war, men are made monsters. Some are true to their nature, others more embellished. But it is not that what matters, rather the power of fear. For fear stokes anxiety, desperation and woe, until suddenly, to beat back the same monsters they so feared, they let demons into their house and find themselves torn limb from limb.

After a decade of unassailable murder, those left to sing the internationale are not hopeful visionaries or poets, but men bathed in the smoke of war and the blood of their comrades, the survivors of a dying breed. Those who, at any cost, will claw their way to retribution in Venezuela's final hour.
